2.12.betting_forecast: 11/10 Diamont Katie, 3/1 Mr Ubiquitous, 7/2 Me Tarzan, 7/1 Noble Guest, 14/1 Way To Dubai, 40/1 Dancing Terror.
2.12.spotlight_verdict: The one with perhaps the most upside is the penalised DIAMONT KATIE who was returning from wind surgery when winning last week. Mr Ubiquitous is a likeable type and he's feared most ahead of Me Tarzan.[Alistair Jones]

horses.spotlight_comment: First and second in two 7f novices at Lingfield the winter before last, but having been off for a year, he's trailed home last in 1m/7f handicaps (tried a hood and blinkers last time); makes turf debut with lots to prove.
Back from a wind operation when winning comfortably last week at Pontefract (6f, good); carries a penalty but should be hard to beat if as good again, as returning to 7f won't hinder her at all.
Four wins divided between AW and turf; ideally positioned through the race when narrowly scoring at Kempton (7f) but this consistent 4yo has clear claims.
horses.breeding: b g Bungle Inthejungle - Petite Georgia

horses.spotlight_comment: Strike-rate of 6-16 so he knows how to win and only 3lb higher than for his half-length reappearance success at Kempton (7f, AW); every chance.
Had 15 races; second career win when prevailing narrowly over C&D in September and following efforts weren't too shoddy; still on a competitive mark but he does lack a recent run.
horses.breeding: br g Mohaather - Maid For Winning

horses.spotlight_comment: Has won only once since making his British debut in October 2023; has threatened plenty of times but has been very poor in last two races.
horses.breeding: b g Holy Roman Emperor - Leading Queen

2.47.betting_forecast: 8/11 Nevasca Cinza, 2/1 Creative Queen, 4/1 Firewalker, 100/1 Izzy Fast, Shining Guest, Unique Procedure.
2.47.spotlight_verdict: This looks best left to NEVASCA CINZA who sets the standard on form and he can no doubt progress further. Firewalker (second choice) and Creative Queen have made rather underwhelming starts given their pedigrees and what they cost, but it's too early to be getting negative about either.[Alistair Jones]

horses.spotlight_comment: 800,000euros breeze-up 2yo; a beaten favourite in both her races, in a three-runner event last year and only midfield at Kempton (7f) three weeks ago; still early days but it's been an underwhelming start.

Cost 360,000gns as a foal; beaten at 1-4 on debut and cut out quickly when again prominent in the betting at Doncaster (7f) one month ago; held a 2,000 Guineas entry that day but not now; may step up but has to.
Modest RPRs in her first two races and doesn't look up to winning a maiden.

All runs over 6f; left the Russell/Scudamore stable for 100,000gns in October (gelded afterwards) after competitive shows at Carlisle and Hamilton; produced another on yard debut in a good-looking novice at Leicester; sets the standard and should have a lot more to offer.
Beat one home on debut here (7f) before trailing in last at Ascot (6f); absent since July.
Beaten about 12l at Nottingham ten days ago (6f, good) when a 100-1 chance; the hood is retained.

3.22.betting_forecast: 100/30 Keep It Classic, 7/2 Darkest Red, 9/2 Lucky Sevens, 5/1 Sea Mehalah Run, 11/2 Montu, 8/1 Cracking Anna, 10/1 Sporty
3.22.spotlight_verdict: The market needs checking as a few of these could be open to improvement on their handicap debuts, notably Keep It Classic who is also raised in distance. Another up in trip is DARKEST RED who didn't get the run of the race when a market mover on his first run after being gelded. Lucky Sevens can run his race but he doesn't look well in under a penalty.[Alistair Jones]

horses.spotlight_comment: Gelded after last season and was only 9-2 for his reappearance in a 1m handicap at Lingfield (AW) where he was running on after a wide trip; raised in distance and the dam stayed this far; respected.
horses.breeding: b g Lope Y Fernandez - Accede

horses.spotlight_comment: Has beaten one rival in three starts (7f-1m); has been gelded ahead of this handicap debut and makes sense to check the betting; stable also represented by Darkest Red.
One of the lesser lights at his strong yard but may show improvement now handicapping upped in distance (from 7f; dam won over this far) and fitted with headgear; market could be informative.
horses.breeding: b g Too Darn Hot - I'm So Fancy

horses.spotlight_comment: Easily best form when he responded well for pressure to lead late on over C&D last week (first-time cheekpieces); that was from 1lb out of the weights so he's 5lb higher here with a penalty, but that doesn't make him well in.
Has found his level in handicaps and beaten under 2l in his last three from 9.4f to 1m4f; handicapped about right but Alice Bond brings her 7lb claim into the equation this time; entered
Eight-race maiden who has finished behind Montu in her last two races; more needed.
Very minor level of form in her qualifying races, all over 7f (tongue tied in the latest); like a few in here, she's entitled to raise her profile now sent into a low-grade handicap.

horses.breeding: b f Iffraaj - The Jean Genie

3.57.betting_forecast: 4/5 Pershalla, 9/4 Sword Of Wessex, 4/1 One Million Dreams, 16/1 Atlantic Sunset.
3.57.spotlight_verdict: Pershalla has to rate the most likely winner but ONE MILLION DREAMS is a feasible alternative on his first run back with Nick Littmoden.[Alistair Jones]

horses.spotlight_comment: 1-14 for Charlie Johnston, the win coming off 7lb higher at Newmarket last summer (1m4f); that was in a new visor and he struggled afterwards, including in blinkers that are now reapplied; joined this yard for 1,000gns.
Not a lot to show for his runs on the Flat or over jumps for previous yard but he's back with Nick Littmoden for whom he did well in Flat handicaps last year; on a competitive mark.
horses.breeding: ch g No Risk At All - Indian Lizzy

horses.spotlight_comment: Lightly raced for a 4yo; seemingly all the better for her comeback run, and the fitting of a hood, when finding the most to lead near the line at Kempton (1m4f, AW) 20 days ago; back up 4lb but in form and probably capable of better.

0-8 for Charlie Fellowes; four runs for current yard, the pick when a close fifth over 1m5f at Lingfield (AW) three runs back; pretty poor since and he's now had lots of chances over various distances.

4.28.betting_forecast: 11/4 Miss Nightfall, 3/1 Lady Mariko, Shallow, 6/1 Lady Manzor, 10/1 Havana Pusey, 12/1 Bridget's View, Ironist.
4.28.spotlight_verdict: Lady Manzor is interesting as the cheekpieces appeared to have a positive impact at Lingfield in a race that panned out none too favourably. She's feared, as is Bridget's View, but MISS NIGHTFALL can make her class count on this return to handicap company.[Alistair Jones]

horses.spotlight_comment: 8lb higher than for her only handicap win but was not beaten far in a blanket finish at Lingfield (7f, AW; stable debut) and the tongue-tie tried when below her best last time is swiftly removed; better now than when last seen on turf earlier in career; should go well.
Last season went well in 6f/7f handicaps and was only 3l away in a Group 3 on one occasion; however, that campaign ended badly and her reappearance at the Craven meeting was no better.
horses.breeding: b m Havana Grey - Pusey Street Lady

horses.spotlight_comment: Course winner last September over 6f on soft ground when 3lb lower; ran okay after her break last week but this is much tougher than usual.

In first-time cheekpieces she was a closing fourth last time at Lingfield (7f, AW) in a race she won the previous year; all three wins have come on the AW but has comparable turf form (0-3); enters the reckoning.
C&D winner who did well to win over 6f at Kempton (AW) 22 days ago as this is probably more her trip; however, the rise in grade off a 6lb higher mark asks questions of her.

Has only won a novice in 13 starts but has some classy form to her name, notably a close fifth in a Group 3 over this trip last September; has contested Listed or Group races in her last four starts (first attempt at 1m on return) and her handicap form is very solid.
horses.breeding: b f Sands Of Mali - Dusky Maid

horses.spotlight_comment: Five-time winner who lurks on a good mark; hasn't been at her best this year, though January's run was okay and if new cheekpieces do the trick then she could be dangerous.

5.03.betting_forecast: 5/2 Moonhall Lass, 7/2 Griselda, No Gain, 13/2 Dion Baker, 8/1 Grand Citadel, 10/1 Sir Rodneyredblood, 12/1 Top Biller, 20/1
5.03.spotlight_verdict: This should be run at a good clip as Grand Citadel is unlikely to hang about back at 6f and Top Biller goes from the front too. Moonhall Lass (second choice) and Griselda have good claims but NO GAIN returns to 6f with blinkers added and she's worth chancing.[Alistair Jones]

horses.spotlight_comment: Former Charles Hills inmate who is now 0-24; well beaten in both his races following a long absence.
Has been struggling on the AW but he's 0-30 in that scene and all four wins have been on turf, albeit over 7f; lurks on a dangerous mark but this trip is not ideal.
Only 3-35 so hard to win with and since going close on the AW in January she's lost her way; others preferred.
Only win was at 7f and four of her last five races have been at 1m; stuck around here 17 days ago despite developing a clear lead and expect similar tactics back at 6f.
Won three nurseries for George Scott; not the same filly now but handicapped accordingly and went close at Southwell (6f, AW) 17 days ago.
horses.breeding: b f Kodi Bear - Geizy Teizy

horses.spotlight_comment: Failed to win in 22 Irish starts but made a positive debut for James Owen when a close third at Southwell (6f, AW); likely contender with cheekpieces back on (ran okay in them when tried once in Ireland).

Tried all sorts of trips for previous yard but still quite lightly raced; tongue-tie and cheekpieces fitted for her two runs for current yard, only 2l away on the first occasion (6f) and the drop back to 5f found her out last time; could be interesting returned to 6f with blinkers given a go.
Chelmsford specialist who ran another sound race there on final start in March; only 1-17 on turf but has course form and this mark gives him a chance.
horses.breeding: ch g Roderic O'Connor - Red Blooded Woman

horses.spotlight_comment: Front-runner who got upset in the stalls and was slowly away last time at Wolverhampton; his previous two runs were also below best form and easy lead looks unlikely with Grand Citadel in the field.
horses.breeding: b g Due Diligence - Balancing Act

5.35.betting_forecast: 7/4 Go Lockers Go, 11/4 Takincareofbizness, 4/1 Saeculamation, 8/1 Zoustar Dreams, 10/1 Blueaway, 12/1 Sea Her Excel, 14/1
5.35.spotlight_verdict: On the back of a positive handicap debut at Nottingham for which he was made favourite, TAKINCAREOFBIZNESS (nap) appeals most. Go Lockers Go is the clear danger arriving here on the back of a win, while Saeculamation ran well enough on Sunday to merit attention.[Alistair Jones]

horses.spotlight_comment: All runs on the AW and in a hood; sent off 15-8 favourite for her handicap debut (5f) but was in rear throughout and has since left Rod Millman for 6,000gns; has to be of some interest.

Can take a strong hold but has still run well in both his handicaps at Chelmsford (5f/6f) since being gelded and was nicely on top last time (hood returned); dropping back to 5f shouldn't hinder too much in this weak a race; raised 6lb.
Chelmsford winner at 6f; more exposed than some in here but he ran well two days ago at Nottingham having been given every chance.
Last season's third came in a three-runner race; beaten 10l on Sunday's handicap debut at Nottingham (6f; 10-1); the hood tried then is removed.
August's debut at Windsor was encouraging but she's not beaten a rival since then; makes handicap debut after 150 days away.

Well beaten on his three starts on AW last year but gelded prior to his handicap debut at Nottingham (5f) in which he finished fourth in a field of 17; interesting that he went off favourite that day and probably capable of better.
horses.breeding: b g Bungle Inthejungle - Stars In The Sky

horses.spotlight_comment: Competitive in 5f/6f AW maidens but backward steps since then, finishing last on handicap debut when tried in blinkers latest; retains some potential with the headgear now left off.
horses.breeding: ch f Zoustar - A Huge Dream

horses.spotlight_comment: Beaten between 12.5l and 15.5l in maiden/novice races on the AW (9.4f/7f); nicely bred and disappointing should she not be a great deal more competitive off this low a mark.
Left James Ferguson for 1,600gns after showing precious little in four 1m races last autumn (maidens/novices); handicapped accordingly if nothing else; has been gelded.
Poor so far, including two handicaps at about 1m on the AW when big prices; opposable.
Seven defeats include four handicaps and she was well held when twice placed; still commands some respect in this modest handicap given she's shown ability and has dropped to a career-low mark.
